messages:
nina.sales: quick heads-up 1 Globex's procurement reviewed the docs. they like the quote but raised two blockers: HSM-backed KMS proof in DPA and Net60 payment terms requiring exec countersign. asking if we can provide temporary POC access before PO.

leo.legal: thanks. legal needs three items: (1) remove or cap unlimited liability in Section 10, (2) add subprocessor carve-out language in DPA with a required HSM attestation, (3) confirmation on export control clause applicability. please share redline PDF.

globex.poc: correct on HSM attestation. our security team requires evidence of key separation and an HSM integration checklist. we typically issue PO after countersign but can approve a 7-day trial access for evaluation.

sam.engineering: we can run Redwood Private in the customer's VPC and connect to their HSM, or bind Dedicated with HSM tie-in. i'll prepare an HSM/KMS checklist and a short diagram. time to stand up for POC: ~48hrs once certs and endpoint are provided.

ana.finance: Net60 without PO is allowed only with Finance VP signoff. standard practice: require PO before provisioning for non-paying trials. if Sales wants exception, please route a waiver form. also need explicit billing contact on orderform.

ciara.solutions: compromise suggestion: sign orderform + MSA with an "initial trial provisioning" clause: grant 7-day POC access post-signature, provisioning contingent on PO within 30 days else trial suspended. that keeps executive countersign for payment terms but allows evaluation.

docsignbot: automated: template flows available:
1) Order Form -> Sales sign -> Exec countersign -> DocuSign envelope OF-3822221111
2) MSA redline review -> Legal finalize PDF -> DocuSign envelope MSA-3822221111
Please attach final PDFs to proceed.

leo.legal: ciara's clause seems reasonable. i'll prepare a short amendment: "Trial access granted for 7 days post-execution; continued provisioning requires PO within 30 days. failure to produce PO results only in suspension of trial resources and does not constitute breach." will add DPA exhibit with HSM attestation checklist request.

sam.engineering: note for ops: for HSM binding we need their KMS endpoint, CSR/cert, and IAM role mapping. will post checklist here in next message. small config note: Dedicated+HSM requires mapping of key alias and token exchange.

globex.poc: please send DocuSign envelope to purchasing@globex.com and cc secops@globex.com. our buyer can issue PO once exec signs. we'll prepare certs.

nina.sales: i'll assemble orderform now. draft snippet: 
```
Orderform: Globex Systems POC
SKU: POC-Private-7d - $8,500
One-time: HSM-Integration Guide & Setup - $2,000
Payment terms: Net60 (50% invoiced on countersign; remainder due upon PO issuance)
Trial: 7-day access post-execution, contingent on PO within 30 days
Billing contact: billing@globex.com
```

ana.finance: add invoice milestone line items in the orderform and confirm billing contact. 50/50 milestone acceptable if legal ensures countersign triggers invoice.

leo.legal: i'll upload the redline MSA + DPA with HSM exhibit by EOD. once uploaded i'll request SOC2/HSM reviewer to add an attestation statement or link to our compliance artifacts.

sam.engineering: attaching (soon) HSM/KMS checklist. ops note: please expedite cert exchange to meet the 48hr standup window.

nina.sales: final asks: @leo.legal please upload PDFs and confirm envelope ids, @ana.finance confirm invoice milestone wording, @sam.engineering post the checklist. i'll create the DocuSign envelopes and send to purchasing@globex.com. :thumbsup:
